# CSI Linux

> CSI Linux is a comprehensive cybersecurity and digital forensics platform offering specialized tools, training, and professional certifications for investigators and security professionals.

CSI Linux provides an integrated ecosystem for cybersecurity professionals focused on OSINT, digital forensics, dark web investigation, and incident response. The platform combines specialized tools with a structured certification academy to develop certified investigators across multiple disciplines.

## Key Topics

- OSINT (Open Source Intelligence)
- Digital Forensics
- Dark Web Investigation
- Incident Response
- Malware Analysis
- Cybersecurity Tools
- CSI Linux Academy
- Certifications (CSIL-CI, CSIL-COA, CSIL-CDWI, CSIL-CCFI, CSIL-CSMI, CSIL-C3S)
- Tor Network
- Tails OS
- Whonix
- Social Media Investigation
- Covert Communications
- Instructor Certification

## Certifications & Training

- [CSI Linux - Cybersecurity & Digital Forensics](https://csilinux.com): Main hub for CSI Linux certifications including CSIL-CI, CSIL-COA, CSIL-CDWI, CSIL-CCFI, CSIL-CSMI, CSIL-C3S, and CSIL-INST programs through CSI Linux Academy
